描述_EN: the model’s eyes bring animation to the plant, creating what huang yan describes as a ‘mutual interaction’ between the spirit of the plant and that of the model. this work is from a series of four in which huang yan paints the faces of models with images of plants closely associated with chinese culture. these flowers ‘embody the spirit of the literati’ – a reference to the chinese scholars who believed in the oneness of man and nature.
描述_ZN: 模特的眼睛给植物带来了活力，创造了黄岩所说的植物和模特的精神之间的 "相互作用"。 这件作品来自于黄岩的四个系列作品，黄岩在模特的脸上画上了与中国文化密切相关的植物形象。 这些花 "体现了文人的精神"--指的是那些相信人与自然合一的中国学者们。
